newsitem.title: USA: HSN Inc to buy into Ticketmaster - NYT. [CORRECTED 12:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: HSN Inc to buy into Ticketmaster - NYT. [CORRECTED 12:50 GMT]

text.p: HSN Inc has agreed to buy a 50 percent stake in Ticketmaster Group Inc, the New York Times said.
(Corrects company name throughout, from Home Shopping Network Inc to HSN Inc.)

In its Tuesday edition, the Times quoted unnamed sources close to the talks as saying that HSN is acquiring 47.5 percent of the stake now held by Paul Allen, a co-founder of Microsoft Corp, for $210 million of its stock.
The balance, 2.5 percent, is to be acquired on the open market.
HSN is the largest home shopping company in the U.S.

The Times said the acquisition is designed to help both companies offer home shopping services while also cutting costs. Ticketmaster is the exclusive ticket sales agent for nearly two-thirds of the nation's 10 million seats at theaters, stadiums and concert halls.
